name: Vampnote
description: Heft the lance at its balance point with both hands and settle the weight against the hip.

name: Easing Impact
description: Walk forward with the lance held level at waist height and the point steady while the feet roll heel to toe.

name: Descending Graper
description: Drive the lance point forward from the hip along one straight line into the target's torso.

name: Counterbalance Strike
description: Reverse the lance and stamp its iron-shod butt down onto a fallen or crouching foe.

name: Saddlepause
description: Hold the shaft crosswise in both hands and shove a swinging weapon wide of the body.

name: Vamppace
description: Slide the rear foot back one pace and bring the point around to face the foe again.

name: Saddlegauge
description: Set the feet wide and plant the butt on the ground so the legs take the weight of the lance.

name: Vampdash
description: Thrust the heavy point short and fast at the target's waist from a settled stance.

name: Momentum Blow
description: Step onto the lead leg while the arms run the shaft out to full reach against an armored torso.

name: Folded Bellrest
description: Swing the middle of the shaft across to slap a thrusting weapon off its line.

name: Settled Lanceshaft
description: Drop the point toward the ground and raise the butt so a low cut slides away along the shaft.

name: Kind Vamplate
description: March with the lance sloped on the shoulder and the point angled up, ready to drop level on command.

name: Firm Lanceguard
description: Snap the point from sloped carry to level and drive it forward in one continuous motion.

name: Firm Tilt
description: Jab short and fast along the shaft beside a neighbor's lance without crossing his line.

name: Backward Coronel
description: Turn a quarter circle on the heel while the lance swings round level to the new front.

name: Lowered Couchrest
description: Catch an incoming blade on the iron collar behind the head and shove it down and aside.

name: Impactamble
description: Advance in a steady crouch with the point lowered at knee height to threaten a foe's legs.

name: Bowlpause
description: Hook the butt behind a rushing man's heel and heave to break his stride.

name: Coronel Note
description: Hang the lance from the carrying strap across the chest so both hands stay free until needed.

name: Narrow Shatter
description: Unsling the lance, let the point fall level and thrust in the same pulling-down motion.

name: Descending Lancehead
description: Whip the trailing butt around at knee height to rap a foe's legs aside.

name: Skipping Arrestrest
description: Pivot on the lead foot with a long stride so the lance swings onto the new front.

name: Tripping Shatter
description: Slide both hands up the shaft and punch the point short to knock a crowding foe off balance.

name: Vamphusk
description: Raise the shaft overhead on locked arms so a downward blow slides off along the wood.

name: Saddlereview
description: Dig the iron butt into the ground behind the rear foot and wedge it with the heel.

name: Hard Bowl
description: Tilt the point up at a charging horse's chest so its own weight carries it onto the iron.

name: Hooding Graper
description: Drop to one knee behind the planted shaft so the charge meets the point and not the body.

name: Bowlamble
description: Slip one long step off the oncoming line at the last moment and swing the point to follow.

name: Narrow Bowl
description: Thrust short into a rider's flank as he sweeps past the braced position.

name: Arrestrest Count
description: Cross shafts with the neighbor on either side so the line holds as one hedge of points.

name: Hitching Impact
description: Lever the shaft against a rider's leg as he passes and pull him sideways out of the saddle.

name: Impactdodge
description: Pull the butt free, skip back two paces and plant it again before the next rider arrives.

name: Graperreview
description: Settle the seat deep and read the horse's gait through the knees before raising the lance.

name: Smooth Vamplate
description: Tuck the shaft under the arm and seat its butt in the rest at the breast.

name: Narrow Tilt
description: At a steady trot hold the couched point on the target's center and let the horse carry the stroke home.

name: Sideways Momentum
description: Guide the horse through a gentle turn with the rein hand alone while the couched lance stays level.

name: Lanceshaft Husk
description: Angle the lance across the horse's neck to turn aside a cut from the near flank.

name: Saddlehit
description: Raise the point at the instant of contact so the lance rides up and pierces beneath the guard.

name: Light Couchrest
description: Pull the point clear and wheel the horse away so the lance leaves the wound without snapping.

name: Watching Counterbalance
description: Rise on the stirrups with straight knees to lower the center of weight before the lance falls level.

name: Judging Lanceguard
description: Pin the shaft to the ribs with the elbow so it cannot kick back at the moment of impact.

name: Saddledrop
description: Lean into the saddle at a gallop and let the leveled point strike where the horse's momentum aims it.

name: Graperdodge
description: Press the heels into the horse's flanks and sit deep to slow it from a gallop within three strides.

name: Bellrest Wedge
description: Lay the lance flat along the horse's shoulder to throw off a counter-thrust after a missed pass.

name: Steady Vamplate
description: Lower the point and glance along the shaft to judge distance and angle before the next run.

name: Skipping Momentum
description: Hold the horse to an even pace along the rail so the point stays at one height the whole run.

name: Firm Ride
description: Strike the painted target shield squarely at its center with the point at full run.

name: Impact Drop
description: Strike the target high and let the shaft snap clean at its thin neck so the wrist is spared.

name: Lancehead Pause
description: Tilt the shaft outward from the rail side to turn off an opponent's point as the riders pass.

name: Tilt Pace
description: Wheel the horse in a wide arc after the pass and seat the lance in the rest for the next run.

name: Graperdash
description: Dip the point at a canter to thread a hanging ring and lift it clear on the shaft.

name: Straight Ride
description: Strike a standing post at a slant so the point bites low and holds fast.

name: Ridebump
description: Hit the swinging arm of the quintain dead center and clear it before the counterweight comes around.

name: Kind Counterbalance
description: Keep both eyes on the ring along the shaft's line and hold the point steady as the horse bounds.

name: Easing Arrestrest
description: Check the horse mid-run and reset its stride so the second ring comes into line without a swerve.

name: Resting Bellrest
description: Turn the lance up to bat away the post's swinging sandbag before it strikes the shoulder.

name: Measured Lanceguard
description: Lean down along the horse's shoulder with a firm knee grip and extend the lance to a ring near the ground.

name: Tiltstay
description: Collect the horse with a firm rein pull after the last ring so the shaft settles back to the rest.

name: Watching Lancehead
description: Hold reins and lance in one hand while the other steadies the shaft, keeping both quiet at the walk.

name: Low Coronel
description: Drop the reins to the neck and thrust one-handed at a foot soldier closing from the side.

name: Lanceshaft Skitter
description: Steer by a touch of rein on the horse's neck to weave between two posts without lowering the point.

name: Saddlestay
description: Cross the rein hand under the shaft and lift both to turn aside a sword cut at the head.

name: Forward Bowl
description: Twist in the saddle and drive the heavy butt backward into a rider closing from behind.

name: Locking Graper
description: Let the reins fall slack for a heartbeat and thrust the point at the enemy's mount to startle it.
